description: project_members.getProjectMembers (GET /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members): (1) the 200 response is a oneOf whose first branch is a bare `{type: object}`, which degrades the whole union to unknown — collapse it to the real paginated shape so `{members, pagination}` types cleanly; (2) the live API returns `pagination: {}` on a fresh project (probed 2026-08-13), so drop the pagination sub-required; (3) the live API returns 404 `not_found` for a deleted/missing project — add the 404 response so the reconciler's observe step gets a typed NotFound.
